name: Prepare EAA Conformance Evidence
summary: Map accessibility results to the requirement set and version an owner declared, keeping verified, asserted, stale and absent apart.
description: Prepare the accessibility evidence a named owner needs for a European Accessibility Act decision, resolving each requirement's precondition and marking every one verified, asserted, stale, not applicable, exempt with assessment, or absent. Use before an accessibility statement, a supplier answer, or a conformity decision.
refuses: It does not declare conformity, finalise a statement, or report an obligation as met.
It does not decide whether a law applies to the organisation, classify its role, or select the requirement set or its version on the owner's behalf.
It does not state a presumption of conformity as its own conclusion, nor report one from a version the owner has not shown to be cited in the Official Journal.
It does not present a supplier claim, a stale result, or a requirement excluded by precondition as verified evidence.
